change_basis: Owner governance change: General Manager approval is required before an expense is fully approved

governance_need.target: An employee can submit a revisioned expense; an authorized first-stage approver must approve it; then an authorized General Manager must approve the same exact revision before the expense is finally approved, while rejection/revision history remains preserved.
governance_need.current: Attempt-1 implementation exists but the prior one-stage approval target was superseded during development.
governance_need.gap: Re-establish Function validity and evidence under explicit actor roles and mandatory two-stage approval.

function_loops.target: Employee can create/edit a draft and submit a valid immutable expense revision for review.
Only an actor with explicit approver authority, who is not the submitter, can perform first-stage approve/reject on the exact submitted revision.
Only an actor with explicit general_manager authority can perform final approve/reject after first-stage approval, and final approval applies to the same exact revision.
A rejection at either review stage can be revised into a new revision and resubmitted while preserving prior revision and decisions.
Neither first-stage nor final approval can float across a changed or superseded expense revision.
Expense revisions and both stages of decisions remain inspectable as ordered history with actor role.
Expense, actor-role, revision and decision history survives application/store restart.
Employee, first-stage approver and General Manager can exercise supported paths through a browser UI.

stale_effect.effect: approval-related prior Function basis is stale/realign because upstream governance target changed
